quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach this intersection. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians cross first. You must stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for people working on or near the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for people working on or near the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers are on or near the road. Drive carefully through work zones.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even without a stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always let pedestrians cross first. Watch for pedestrians when driving through intersections or turning.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You must turn either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: A Y intersection is ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to stop.

questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop. Wait for vehicles and pedestrians to clear before you go.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The road ahead has loose gravel.
The road has been sanded for ice.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead has loose gravel.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the road ahead has loose gravel. Drive carefully because your tires will have less grip on gravel.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and warn of hazards ahead. This sign tells you lanes are shifting. Follow the new lane path.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and warn of hazards ahead. This sign tells you a playground is near. Watch for children in or near the road.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn of construction zones. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead. Follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction of the arrow. In this case, it curves left. You may see several chevron signs along the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that from this lane, you can turn right or continue straight at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work zones. This sign tells you that penalties and fines are doubled if you drive recklessly in a work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of railroad crossings. This sign tells you that a railroad crossing is coming. Watch for trains.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order for traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: On vertical traffic lights, red is always at the top and green at the bottom. On horizontal lights, red is always on the left and green on the right.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used for no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings prepare drivers for road hazards. This sign alerts you that the road shoulder ahead is lower than the paved road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The road ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings warn of upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work zones. This sign tells you that workers may be on or near the road. Drive with extra caution.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Safe speed limit for a residential area.
Safe speed limit for leaving a highway.
Safe speed limit for entering a highway.
Safe speed limit for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Safe speed limit for leaving a highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed for highway exits. The number shown is the recommended speed (for example, 30 mph).

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs tell you to slow down at an intersection. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right only after a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This sign is a law you must obey. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: Keep your speed the same until you see the next sign.
Do not slow down or traffic will back up.
Slow down only if you want to.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you to begin slowing down your vehicle. The new speed limit will start at the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what must you do?

options.text: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and other traffic.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and look for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and other traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely and check for pedestrians and traffic. Only go when the intersection is clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the bridge or overpass ahead is low. Do not go through if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (for example, 13 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and honk your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through it means the action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about road hazards ahead. This sign alerts you to watch for buggies.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people crossing the street. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through it means the action is prohibited. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign shows the direction traffic flows on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street in the wrong direction.
Do not drive in this lane.
If you turn left on a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: If you turn left on a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign is used with traffic lights. It tells drivers turning left on green that they do not have the right-of-way. You must wait for oncoming traffic to pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a sharp right turn is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is ahead. The road splits into two separate one-way roads with a median between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign is posted at traffic lights. It means you cannot turn right when the light is red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that a lane is ending. Prepare to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right. Slow down to 35 mph.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to 35 mph.
Merge ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right. Slow down to 35 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a Yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and cars on the other road go first. Stop only if you need to.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let the traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you about a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake damage or crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows a bicycle crossing or path ahead. Drive carefully because bicycles often cross or ride beside traffic in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They warn you about hazards ahead. This sign tells you the road may be slippery when wet. Drive carefully because your vehicle may be harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They warn you about hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What is the main concern when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may be out of alignment because one side of your car is higher.
You could damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
You could hydroplane if the shoulder has water on it.
You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: What should you do if you see this sign above your lane?

options.text: You can continue straight or exit from your current lane.
You can stay in your lane and continue straight.
You must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means this lane does not continue through the interchange. The lane becomes an exit ramp. You can change lanes to continue straight, or you must exit if you stay in this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that pedestrians may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign is posted near intersections to remind drivers not to block the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers they can turn left or go straight from this lane at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean stop. You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road conditions ahead. This sign tells you a yield sign is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic only goes in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic only goes in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: A one-way sign shows the direction traffic is allowed to flow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road turns sharply left, then right.
The road curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will make a sharp turn to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead turns sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What is this sign warning you about?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks reserved parking spaces in lots. These spaces are for vehicles with a handicap sticker, tag, or license plate.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Speed limit is 35 mph after the curve.
Drive at least 35 mph around the curve.
Curve ahead. Slow to 35 mph or less.
Stay in the right lane if driving under 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: Curve ahead. Slow to 35 mph or less.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a curve ahead and recommends driving at 35 mph or slower through it.

questions.question: What does a green arrow mean on a lane control signal?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road crosses a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road crosses a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or barrier.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a shared center lane for left turns from both directions. Do not use this lane for normal driving.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
Two lanes of opposite traffic are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low overpass ahead. Do not pass if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn that a school is nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians on or near the road. This sign shows either a school crossing or a school zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction zones. Construction is dangerous for both drivers and workers. This sign tells you that construction is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means an action is not allowed. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign tells you a fire station is nearby. Watch for emergency vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign tells you the road has low clearance ahead.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand point upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm points upward, they are signaling a right turn. Adjust your driving if you see this signal.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always stay at your current speed.
Speed up to avoid slowing traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When traffic is merging, make room for entering vehicles. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let traffic in.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows there are multiple lanes for left turns. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot enter the road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign directs you around roadwork on a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
You can drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This "Keep right" sign tells drivers that a traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. Drive to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers that deer may cross the road in this area.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
These lanes are for buses and vehicles with multiple passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that a winding road is ahead. Slow down and be ready to turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road is joining from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road is joining from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is ahead. A road is joining from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends. Move to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends. Move to the left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the right lane ends. Traffic in the right lane must merge left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to stop at a red light or watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A sharp left turn is ahead.
Watch for people crossing the road.
Take the detour to avoid unsafe driving conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take the detour to avoid unsafe driving conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that traffic patterns or routes are changing due to road work. Follow the detour signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful in construction zones. This sign tells you the right lane will be closed ahead due to construction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that a new lane will be added ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a steep downhill slope ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location. Do not make a right turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign with black markings on white. You must obey it. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles in this area.

questions.question: From the center lane, what can you do?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it to pass other cars or to drive straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign tells you to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers the rules they must follow. This sign says you cannot park here.

questions.question: What does the speed limit sign show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed in good road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed in good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the limit if conditions are bad. Always adjust your speed for weather and road conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you to reduce speed because a sharp turn is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that deer may cross the road here. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped, yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign means the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and let others go first.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and let others pass if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and let others pass if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let all vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians pass safely before you continue.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people.
Certain turns are allowed from certain lanes.
Both lanes need to merge smoothly together.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. Only buses and cars with the driver plus the required number of passengers can use this lane, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers the rules they must follow. This sign is usually posted at the end of one-way streets. It warns you not to drive in the wrong direction. Stop and turn around if you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers the rules they must follow. This sign tells drivers in the left lane that they must turn left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes of traffic are about to become one lane.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Follow a detour to the right.
Get ready to enter a one-way street.
Stay on the main highway if you can.
Follow a detour to the right, but only if it is convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow a detour to the right.
questions.explanation: This orange sign tells you to take an alternate route around a blocked road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings tells you that a detour is coming up in 1,000 feet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that pedestrians may cross the road ahead. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: This orange sign warns you that construction work is ahead. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you that the road will curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it rains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings tells you that the road will soon be divided with traffic going in opposite directions.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that you cannot enter from this direction because it is a one-way street or expressway ramp.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you that the bridge ahead has narrow lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign tells you to be ready to stop ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns you that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower ahead.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down when you approach it. Trains cannot stop or yield, so you must let them pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has many curves or turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. It means you should stay on the right side to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand are extended downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point downward, the driver is signaling that they plan to stop. Be ready to adjust your speed if you are following this driver.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. It means you cannot park your vehicle at this location, ever.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the fastest legal speed you can drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with the flow of traffic.
Do not go faster than 50 miles per hour for the next 50 miles.
Police will check speeds for the next 50 miles.
The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.
